title: Trial and Execution of Socrates
description: A dramatic scene depicting the trial and execution of Socrates in ancient Athens. Socrates stands calmly in the center, addressing a group of stern-looking judges and an attentive crowd. The background shows the Athenian courtroom with marble columns and statues. In the foreground, a cup of hemlock is placed on a table, symbolizing his impending execution. The atmosphere is tense and somber, capturing the historical and philosophical significance of this event.
